page.overview:
Who is Brazino Inneundo?

Brazino Inneundo was a Mercenary General who was recruited to defend Trantio against a besieging force from Luccini. Allegedly he relied on the advice of Giovanni Marmalodi.

Brazino died of mushroom poisoning during the siege, for which many accused Lucrezzia Belladonna to be responsible.

His name seems a pun about the words "Brazen Innuendo".
